whatChanged.method: Dynamic factor model news decomposition (statsmodels DynamicFactorMQ.news)
whatChanged.units: Standardized, transformed units of each series: observed is the print, expected is the model's forecast of it before the print.
whatChanged.validation: Decomposition is exact given the fit; the fit is not validated as a forecaster.

regimes.method: Two-state Markov switching per factor: switching mean vs switching variance, BIC
regimes.validation: Descriptive. No regime probability is published until the climatology test (WP3) passes; the factor model behind it reports non-convergence when converged is false.
